entities.summary: Miles Julian Simon is an American former basketball player who is a college basketball announcer for ESPN. As a player, Simon was the Most Outstanding Player of the 1997 NCAA tournament, leading the Arizona Wildcats to the national championship. As a professional, he played briefly in the NBA and then for several domestic leagues around the world.
